summary.oneLiner: Manufacturer of savoury bakery products - breads, buns, pizza bases and Kulcha - sold under the 'American Bakers' brand primarily in Uttar Pradesh.
summary.business: Q&T Foods Limited manufactures, distributes, markets and sells savoury bakery products including breads (Milk, White, Multigrain, Brown), Kulcha, Pav, Burger Bun and Pizza Base under the 'American Bakers' brand. All products are made at a single in-house, ISO 22000:2018 and HACCP certified manufacturing facility in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, and sold through a dealer network of 50+ dealers primarily within Uttar Pradesh.
